summary: WeRide Inc., a Cayman-incorporated, weighted-voting-rights foreign private issuer listed in Hong Kong and the US, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its November 6, 2026 HKEX announcement of a board meeting date. The board meets November 20, 2026 (Beijing/Hong Kong time) to consider and approve unaudited third-quarter 2026 results for the three months ended September 30, 2026, and their publication; management hosts an earnings call the same day at 9:00 P.M. HKT / 8:00 A.M. ET. No transaction terms, advisor, or recommendation are stated. This is a routine results-calendar notice, not a special situation; watch for quarterly disclosures on autonomous-driving commercialization and cash runway.
